messages:
maria: Quick bring-up -- ran mosaic-7b int6 on our GTN slices (longform + Q&A). Short summary below, want ops + product input before recommending rollout.

alexa: cool, numbers?

sam: bench-bot posted the microbench earlier but TL;DR: int6 throughput up ~1.8x vs int8, p95 token latency +12ms on 2k context. Cost per 1k input tokens ~ $0.0032 (int6) vs $0.0056 (int8).

maria: perf + cost look promising. Quality: mean BLEU/ROUGE drops small but there's a tail of failures on multi-step reasoning prompts (about 3.4% regression vs baseline int8). Examples: hallucinated entity in Q&A, and shorter completions in longform summarization.

jordan: can you paste one of the failed prompts and both outputs?

maria: sure. Prompt: "Summarize the following policy memo and list action items for engineering team."

maria: Output (int8): "...Action items: 1) add telemetry, 2) schedule infra review..."

maria: Output (int6): "...Action items: 1) add metric, 2) run audit..."

alexa: subtle but could matter for product UX. Is this from a high-weight slice?

maria: yes — product-critical GTN slice with high conversion. About 18% of our current traffic maps to similar prompts.

sam: suggestion: hybrid routing. Keep int6 for generic chat/short generation (70% traffic), route the GTN policy/longform slice to int8 or int6 with shadow evaluation. That preserves cost wins but protects UX.

bench-bot: microbench results (condensed):
```
model: mosaic-7b
quant: int6
median latency (1k tokens): 62ms
p95 latency (1k tokens): 120ms
throughput vs int8: +82%
wmse quality delta vs int8: +0.9 (higher = worse) on GTN slice
failure rate (slice): 3.4% (n=1200 evals)
```

jordan: do we have per-token economic impact for the GTN funnel? if we route 18% of traffic to int8 how much does that cost us vs all-int8 vs all-int6?

sam: quick calc: assume baseline traffic 100M tokens/day.

- all-int8: 100M * $0.0056/1k = $560/day
- all-int6: 100M * $0.0032/1k = $320/day (saved $240/day)
- hybrid (82% int6 + 18% int8): 82M*$0.0032/1k + 18M*$0.0056/1k = $393/day (saves $167/day vs all-int8)

maria: tradeoff seems reasonable. For GTN impact estimation: if routing protects conversion, preserving even 0.5% conversion uplift is worth ~10x the marginal cost (back-of-envelope).

alexa: recommended rollout plan?

maria: propose:
1) Canary: 5% of GTN traffic -> int6 with real-time shadowing to int8 (compare outputs).
2) Run automated evals on the fly (ROUGE/BLEU + a short human review sample of 200 items).
3) If regression > 2% on critical checks -> block rollout. If regression <= 2% and micro-Econ holds -> 50% traffic hybrid.
4) Full rollout only after 7d with monitoring and quick rollback flag.

jordan: add safety nets: prefix caching differences and tokenization checks. Also keep prompt-specific priming (extra system instruction) for GTN slice to reduce hallucinations.

sam: ops notes: add a routing flag in AB config: `mosaic_int6_gtn` and a fallback policy to `mosaic_int8` on >3% error increase. Also add a token-level cost dashboard for first 48h.

maria: action items:
- sam: implement routing flag + dashboard (ETA 1d)
- bench-bot / jordan: add live shadow comparator and start 2k eval run (ETA today)
- alexa: coordinate product sign-off and prepare 200 human checks (ETA 2d)

alexa: ack. Will prep sample and stakeholders.

jordan: I'll draft a short runbook for rollback and prompt tweaks.

maria: thanks. if anyone sees unexpected drift in the first 24h ping here + tag @oncall. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: scheduled micro-eval job started at 1840000012, will post aggregated diff when complete.

maria: perfect — will hold recommendations until we get the shadow diffs and the 200 human checks.

alexa: one more ask — can we log per-request token deltas (prefix cache hits) so we can model real unit-econ better?

sam: yes, adding `kvcache_hit_ratio` to the telemetry event this afternoon.

maria: great. closing loop here once bench-bot posts results. Thanks team.
